digest.component_or_area: Claude Code agent configuration / MCP tool search
propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction compared to non-deferred tools like grep
The ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH environment variable is the only existing control for tool deferral and is all-or-nothing global (no per-tool or per-server granularity)

A tracked .claude/settings.json file with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false will load all MCP tool schemas upfront, eliminating discovery-step friction for Serena tools at a measured cost of ~25k-64k tokens per session depending on connected MCP servers
The original AC assuming per-tool non-deferral controls is not implementable; the lever controls all connected servers globally, not individual tools
Reverting the change requires only deleting one JSON key, making the context-cost tradeoff reversible and acceptable given the defect cost observed in prior epics
